summary: Parse Server before 8.6.95 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.2 Denial of Service via File Pointer Without URL
details: Parse Server before 8.6.95 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.2 does not resolve file references lacking a URL before passing objects to Cloud Code triggers and LiveQuery, causing an uncaught exception that terminates the process. Attackers able to write to a class with Cloud Code save, find, or delete triggers or LiveQuery enabled, including unauthenticated users when public write access or sign-up is allowed, can crash the server or break subsequent requests.
